nodes.name: Webhook (test email)
nodes.notes: POST {email_id, thread_id, sender, subject, body, received_at}. Enable Header Auth before exposing publicly.

nodes.name: Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Read-only use. Shipped disabled: attach your Gmail credential, then enable.

nodes.name: Mock Emails (8 cases)
nodes.notes: Test harness: 8 synthetic emails with expected results.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: COMPANY_DOMAIN: senders from this domain are treated as internal.

nodes.name: Normalize
nodes.notes: Gmail / webhook / mock -> one shape. Strips HTML, truncates body to 2000 chars.

nodes.name: Read Existing Emails
nodes.notes: One read per run; used for dedupe and thread-alert suppression.

nodes.name: Dedupe
nodes.notes: Already stored (same email_id) -> STOP. No AI, no save, no alert.

nodes.name: Pre-check
nodes.notes: Missing sender / empty body / under 15 words -> skip AI.

nodes.name: Build AI Request
nodes.notes: Wraps the email as untrusted data inside <email> tags.

nodes.name: Gemini Classify
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: name x-goog-api-key, value = your Gemini key. 3 tries, then error output -> needs_review.

nodes.name: Validate & Decide
nodes.notes: Strict validation. needs_review is decided here, in code.

nodes.name: Assign Queue
nodes.notes: queue / label / alert decided before saving.

nodes.name: Save to Sheet
nodes.notes: appendOrUpdate on email_id. Saved BEFORE any alert.

nodes.name: Notify Staff (Telegram)
nodes.notes: Internal staff alert only. Continue on fail: a failed alert never loses the saved record.

nodes.name: Test Report
nodes.notes: Only outputs for the manual test branch: case | expected | actual | PASS/FAIL.

parameters.content:
## AI Email Triage & Routing (Demo)
**Understand -> Classify -> Prioritize -> Route**

The workflow never replies to anyone. Gmail is read-only here; humans handle every email.

Setup: see README. Synthetic data only.

### Test harness
Run Test Cases -> 8 mock emails -> same pipeline -> Test Report (PASS/FAIL).
